mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lymph return route to the arm was most worthwhile: the completed picture brings the separate pieces together and shows why the route matters for tissue fluid.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter. Following a complete route from tissue fluid back to the blood was interesting, although I would hope future required ordering is clearer.
